compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD6: plugins/dso/config/dso-config.reference.conf defines model.provider, model.light, model.standard, model.deep with documented defaults — Anthropic: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 / claude-sonnet-4-6 / claude-opus-4-7; OpenAI: gpt-5.4-nano / gpt-5.4 / gpt-5.5 — and plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md adds four new key sections with valid-value lists (anthropic|openai), per-provider examples, and explicit defaults

## Description
Two purely additive changes:

1. plugins/dso/config/dso-config.reference.conf — add 4 new keys below the existing model.* section:
   ```
   # --- CI provider-agnostic model configuration ---
   model.provider=anthropic
   model.light=claude-haiku-4-5-20251001
   model.standard=claude-sonnet-4-6
   model.deep=claude-opus-4-7
   ```
   OpenAI defaults commented inline:
   ```
   # OpenAI defaults: model.light=gpt-5.4-nano, model.standard=gpt-5.4, model.deep=gpt-5.5
   ```

2. plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md — add 4 new key sections after the existing model.haiku/sonnet/opus sections. Each section must follow the existing template structure:
   - ### `model.provider`
     - Description: CI LLM provider for llm-api-call.sh. Valid values: anthropic | openai. Default: anthropic.
     - Per-provider examples
   - ### `model.light`
     - Description: Model ID for light-tier CI review (used by llm-api-call.sh when tier=light)
     - Defaults: anthropic=claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, openai=gpt-5.4-nano
   - ### `model.standard`
     - Description: Model ID for standard-tier CI review
     - Defaults: anthropic=claude-sonnet-4-6, openai=gpt-5.4
   - ### `model.deep`
     - Description: Model ID for deep-tier CI review (opus-class)
     - Defaults: anthropic=claude-opus-4-7, openai=gpt-5.5

## Unit Test Exemption
Justified: (1) config file has no conditional logic; (2) any test would only assert key existence (change-detector); (3) infrastructure-boundary-only change.
This task does not require a preceding RED test task.

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/config/dso-config.reference.conf (MODIFY — add 4 keys)
- plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md (MODIFY — add 4 doc sections)

- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true

- [ ] model.light key present in dso-config.reference.conf
  Verify: grep -q "^model.light=" plugins/dso/config/dso-config.reference.conf
- [ ] model.standard key present in dso-config.reference.conf
  Verify: grep -q "^model.standard=" plugins/dso/config/dso-config.reference.conf
- [ ] model.deep key present in dso-config.reference.conf
  Verify: grep -q "^model.deep=" plugins/dso/config/dso-config.reference.conf
- [ ] CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md contains model.provider section
  Verify: grep -q "model.provider" plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
- [ ] CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md contains model.light section
  Verify: grep -q "model.light" plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
- [ ] CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md contains model.standard section
  Verify: grep -q "model.standard" plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
